cohort_total_n_excerpt: Veteran American men (272 controls and 144 PC cases) who attended the Durham Veteran American Medical Center between 2004-2009 were enrolled into a case-control study.
reason: The study evaluated prostate cancer overall. The only grade-specific result reported was for Gleason sum <7, which is a nonaggressive/low-grade endpoint and does not establish an aggressive incident analysis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: There was no evidence for associations between B vitamins (folate, B12, and B6) and PC risk.
estimate_classifications.reason: The folate association is explicitly described for prostate cancer risk overall; the abstract does not report an aggressive folate analysis.
